phase: derivation only - nothing applied; no repo code or contract was changed
generator: the W37 deriver; reruns from the export + a scratch copy of the working index
what_this_is: One row per (record, field) whose layer/source/created_by is derivable mechanically, for the 11 entities that carry none today. field: null is the record root. A field row exists only where that field's layer differs from the root's (APP_PLAN D13) or where the value is a denormalized copy of another record's field. Field paths are SHAPE paths, not indexed: every sub-record of a collection shares the collection's layer, so senses[].gloss states it once.

sources.export: corpus/ + course/ as committed; entity globs from contracts/manifest.json
sources.index: db/corpus.sqlite READ FROM A SCRATCH COPY - kanji/vocab/topic/course_module already store layer+source+created_by and the exporter drops them; localized_text.layer already stores the per-field layer
sources.ingest: research/derived/rebuild_manifest.json - which script first writes each table

rules.R1-index+ingest: the working index already stores layer/source/created_by for this record AND the ingest step that created the table agrees; the export simply drops them.
rules.R1-index-recover: the working index stores it; there is no dataset ingest to cross-check against (authored placement tables).
rules.R2-builder-declared: no stored provenance: the record is computed by a named builder whose own docstring declares the layer. source = what the builder computed from.
rules.R3-localized-layer: per-field layer read from localized_text.layer, which already separates the Layer-B translation and the Layer-C note from the Layer-A record.
rules.R4-denormalized-copy: the field is a verbatim copy of another record's field; it inherits that field's provenance and must NOT be queued for review a second time.
rules.R5-inherit-record: localized_text.layer is NULL for this field, so the layer is inherited from the record's own stored layer. Medium: fix by backfilling localized_text.layer, not by guessing here.
rules.R6-single-writer: exactly one tracked script has ever written this field, and it writes a layer.
rules.R7-builder-literal-locale: the pt-BR string is a literal in the builder - not a dataset fact and not a translation. Layer C is the honest reading (the course's own naming of a pedagogical grouping) but it is a RULING, not a derivation.

blocked_by_shape.capability_lesson_map: 266 map values are bare LISTS of capability ids - nowhere to put a field without changing the value shape. The provenance gate already reads these as EMPTY records, so it can never check them.
blocked_by_shape.kana_family: 2 map values are bare LISTS of family objects - same blocker. The 57 family objects inside them could each carry provenance.
